Custard Pudding parfait.desc: A delightful glass parfait layered with sweet cream and fresh fruit, crowned with a rich baked custard flan, whipped cream, and a cherry. Sweet, creamy, and visually stunning!

Choco Dream.desc: A tender chocolate cake layered with airy whipped cream and sweet, juicy strawberries, finished with a silky chocolate frosting and a fresh strawberry on top. Every slice feels a little special.

Strawberry Delight.desc: Light and airy vanilla sponge cake layered with generous amounts of freshly whipped cream and juicy, ripe strawberries. A timeless, refreshing favorite!

Fruity Dream.desc: A light, airy vanilla sponge cake layered with fluffy whipped cream and a colorful medley of fresh seasonal fruits, including banana, grapes, and citrus. Bright, refreshing, and perfectly sweet!

Midsummer Matcha Magic.desc: Vibrant matcha green tea sponge layered with a sweet, pastel pink berry cream, coated in smooth matcha frosting and topped with a cherry. Earthy, sweet, and perfectly balanced!

Lemon Meringue Tart.desc: A buttery pastry base filled with smooth, zesty lemon curd and topped with fluffy, lightly toasted meringue. A refreshing balance of sweet and tangy flavours.

Blueberry Cream Mille-Feuille.desc: Layers of crisp, golden pastry filled with smooth vanilla and blueberry cream. Finished with a delicate purple dusting and fresh blueberries, this elegant dessert offers a lovely mix of creamy, fruity, and buttery flavours.

Bunnys Choco Strawberry Tarts (2).desc: Rich, dark chocolate tarts packed with crunchy nuts, fresh strawberry slices, flower cookies, and a chocolate bunny topper! Decadent, whimsical, and packed with delicious flavor.

Sleepy Bear Pineberry Tart.desc: A buttery, crisp tart shell layered with smooth cream and rare white pineberries, crowned with an adorable sleeping meringue bear! A magical dessert crafted to bring a smile to every bite.

Strawdew Creamy Croissant.desc: A golden, flaky croissant sliced open and filled with rich whipped cream, juicy fresh strawberry slices, and a drizzle of sweet condensed milk. The perfect mix of buttery crispness and sweet fruity goodness!

Whiskered Seal Cream Buns.desc: Soft, golden sponge buns stuffed with cloud-like whipped cream and decorated into the sweetest little seal faces! Finished with a bright red cherry on top, this treat is almost too cute to eat.

Cloud Nine Soufflé Pancakes.desc: Ultra-fluffy Japanese soufflé pancakes that melt in your mouth! Drizzled with silky pink strawberry cream and sprinkled with sweet crushed nuts and strawberries for the ultimate dreamy treat.

Starlight Berry Yogurt Bowl.desc: A dreamy pink yogurt bowl swirled with crunchy chocolate granola, juicy frozen raspberries, and adorable banana stars! It’s bright, refreshing, and tastes like a cozy morning hug in a bowl.
